item.text: I’ll use `CANARY_PYTHON` to read `input.txt` and write the doubled value to `observed.txt`.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc '"$CANARY_PYTHON" -c '"'from pathlib import Path; value = int(Path(\"input.txt\").read_text()); result = f\"smoke-ok:{value * 2}\"; assert result == \"smoke-ok:42\"; Path(\"observed.txt\").write_text(result); print(result)'"
